world_offer_label: the world of the post-apostolic house churches — the generation after the apostles, meeting in homes across the Mediterranean
_comment: Primary-text translations and secondary scholarship drawn from this world's own vetted Source Registry (Doc_02), curated for a participant who wants to go deeper after talking with this world's Representative.

resources.title: The Churches the Apostles Left Behind
resources.author: Raymond E. Brown
resources.note: An accessible look at what happened to different New Testament communities in the decades right after their founding apostle died — the exact transition this world's Representative lives inside.

resources.title: The Apostolic Fathers: Greek Texts and English Translations
resources.author: Michael W. Holmes (ed. and trans.)
resources.note: The standard one-volume translation of the Didache, 1 Clement, Ignatius's letters, Polycarp, and the Shepherd of Hermas — the actual texts most directly behind this world's own voice.

resources.title: The Apostolic Fathers (Loeb Classical Library, 2 vols.)
resources.author: Bart D. Ehrman (ed. and trans.)
resources.note: An alternative complete translation of the same core texts, with facing Greek — a widely available, general-reader-friendly edition of this world's own founding documents.

resources.title: The First Urban Christians: The Social World of the Apostle Paul
resources.author: Wayne A. Meeks
resources.note: A foundational, readable study of how the earliest house-church communities were actually organized socially — the methodological ancestor of how this world's own house-church ecology is reconstructed.

resources.title: From Paul to Valentinus: Christians at Rome in the First Two Centuries
resources.author: Peter Lampe
resources.note: The standard reference on the real topography of Roman house churches — for a participant curious what the physical, social setting of this world's meetings actually looked like.
